Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 100. Category: feat. Non-race Specific D&DBZ Feats.

Can be taken a number of times equal to Ranks in the
“Weight Training” feat.
You have fully acclimated your body to the heighted
weight of your training and can treat it as your standard
gravity.
Whenever you are not under the Heavy Weight
condition you benefit from the Light Weight condition
equal to the amount of times you have taken this feat.
